candidates.label: B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia with febrile neutropenia and right shoulder invasive aspergillosis

response.rationale: The patient has confirmed B-cell precursor ALL. The febrile neutropenia and shoulder lesion are complications. Negative galactomannan makes aspergillosis less likely, favoring bacterial abscess or mucormycosis. Bacterial abscess is more common in neutropenic patients, so it is ranked first.
